instruction: Format the essay with single-space for introduction, double-space for body, 1.5-space for conclusion, and change the font size to 14pt throughout.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the .docx file from the environment and parses non-empty paragraphs, mapping the first three to intro/body/conclusion as expected for this essay document.
Line spacing checks (intro==1.0, body==2.0, conclusion==1.5) correctly map to Single/Double/1.5-Lines paragraph spacing via python-docx's paragraph_format.line_spacing multipliers.
Font size check correctly uses 177800 EMU (14pt × 12700 EMU/pt) and covers all runs across all three paragraphs.
All four instruction requirements are covered with 0.25 partial credit each — complete coverage.
Postconfig saves the file via Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the file-based getter reads fresh, committed state.
Metric function does not use the 'expected' parameter but hardcodes expected values that exactly match the rules dict — not a logic error, just a design choice.

Minor risk: font size check via run.font.size only includes runs with explicitly set sizes. If the user applies 14pt through a paragraph/document style, runs return None and are excluded; empty all_run_sizes causes all_14pt=False (false negative). In practice, LibreOffice GUI font-size changes apply at run level, mitigating this risk.

Minor risk: paragraph identification uses the first 3 non-empty paragraphs globally; if the document has a title or headers before the essay body, indexing could misidentify intro/body/conclusion. Given the known document structure (3 essay paragraphs), this is acceptable.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: To harden font-size checking, also fall back to paragraph_format.font or the paragraph style's font size when run.font.size is None, so that style-level 14pt formatting is also detected.

Consider documenting or asserting the expected paragraph count and structure (e.g., assert exactly 3 non-empty paragraphs) to fail fast and give clearer error messages if the document structure differs.

metadata.explanation: Chains the original line-spacing task with a font size change. Getter downloads the docx and reads paragraph line_spacing (1.0/2.0/1.5) and run font sizes (177800 EMU = 14pt). Metric awards 0.25 per correct spacing and 0.25 if all runs are 14pt. Initial state (all single-space, 12pt) scores 0.25, full credit requires completing both goals.
